$comment: Tool manifest for agents that call the Arboreal inference router. It is descriptive: nothing in the router reads this file. Adjust 'server_url' and transcription to your harness (OpenAI-style function tools, MCP, or a shell alias).

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Send a chat message to whichever engine the router decides should serve it. Returns streamed tokens (SSE) or one JSON body. Queue waits and model switches are invisible to the caller except for keepalive frames.

model.description: Model name as listed by list_models.

thread_id.description: Sent as the X-Inference-Thread header; keeps this conversation's priority and context budget.

required_context_tokens.description: Sent as X-Inference-Required-Context when you know the window you need; the router switches profile rather than failing.

returns.stream: engine frames verbatim; 'data: [router keepalive …]' while queued or switching; error frame then [DONE] on failure

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the models this router can serve right now, and which engine owns each (OpenAI 'models' format).

tools.name: register_thread
tools.description: Give a conversation a priority class so it gets its share of engine capacity. Not enforced today: the router does not clamp the class you ask for and has no caller authentication, so run it on loopback or behind your own proxy.

tools.name: engine_status
tools.description: Which engines are up, their loaded model and context window, queue depths, and per-thread state. Use before deciding whether to wait or retry.

tools.name: read_events
tools.description: Replay the router's decision log from a sequence number (SSE). Each event carries kind, threadId, ticketId, engine, model, reason and an optional numeric value. Kinds include request.enqueued, request.selected, request.streaming_first_token, request.completed, queue.rejected, engine.switch_started, engine.switch_completed, engine.switch_failed.

since_seq.description: Replay events after this sequence number; 0 replays the retained ring.

tools.name: inspect_ticket
tools.description: State of one admitted request: Queued, WaitingForModel, Executing, Completed, Cancelled or Failed, plus the engine serving it and any error code.

id.description: Ticket id from the X-Inference-Ticket response header of the request you want to inspect or cancel.

tools.name: cancel_ticket
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running request and release its reserved engine capacity. Only useful before the first token reaches the caller.

id.description: Ticket id from the X-Inference-Ticket response header of the request you want to inspect or cancel.

tools.name: switch_model
tools.description: Ask the router to load a model on a running engine. It drains in-flight requests first, then re-probes readiness; requests keep their URLs throughout.

profile.description: Optional named context-window profile to serve the new model under.
